entries.description: Wrapped DrawRectFilled() and DrawRectFilledAndStroked() in SaveState()/RestoreState() to prevent fill color bleeding into subsequent drawing operations.
Audited no-color DrawText overload. All SetColorFill calls are in SampleBase.cs only. SaveState/RestoreState fully protects state; no safety net needed.
Searched all 10 sample files for direct SetColorFill()/Fill() calls. Found zero — all fill operations go through DrawRectFilled or DrawRectFilledAndStroked helpers. No sample-level changes needed.
dotnet build succeeded with 0 warnings, 0 errors. dotnet run generated all 10 sample PDFs successfully (10 passed, 0 failed).
dotnet build succeeded with 0 warnings, 0 errors. dotnet test: Passed 562, Failed 0.
Cross-provider verification with gemini-pro (1 round). Session review saved to session-reviews/session-001.md.

Fixed colored DrawText overload: replaced manual SetColorFill(BaseColor.Black) reset with SaveState()/RestoreState() for consistent state management. Rebuild: 0 warnings, 0 errors. Tests: 562 passed. Samples: 10/10 generated.
Cross-provider re-verification with opus (round 2, escalated due to Major severity). Session review appended to session-reviews/session-001.md.

Added ascent offset to SampleBase.DrawText() (both overloads) so y represents visual top of text, not baseline. Adjusted Y offsets in all 10 samples for text inside constrained areas (table rows, boxes, headers) to prevent overflow.
Added ascent offset to TextLayout.DrawText() before the rendering loop. The y parameter now represents the top of the text area in PDF coordinates.
Added BreakWord() helper and character-level fallback in TextLayout.WrapText() and SampleBase.WrapText(). Words exceeding maxWidth are now broken at character boundaries instead of overflowing.
Added SaveState/Clip/RestoreState to S05 ActualSize case. Image is now clipped to the element boundary, preventing overflow beyond the dashed border.

Confirmed S03 line/label misalignment is the same baseline offset issue fixed in Step 1. DrawLabel now places visual top at y, aligning label vertical center (~y+3.2) with the line at y+4. No additional changes needed.

Updated existing SingleLongWord test (now expects character-level breaking). Added 3 new tests: SingleLongWord_ExactFit_NotBroken, SingleCharacter_ExceedsWidth_StillAppears, MixedContent_WithOversizedWord. Updated 3 DrawText return-value tests for ascent offset.
dotnet build succeeded with 0 warnings, 0 errors. dotnet test: Passed 565, Failed 0. dotnet run: 10/10 samples generated successfully.
Cross-provider verification with gemini-pro (1 round). Session review saved to session-reviews/session-002.md.

Fixed S08_Padding.cs: removed extra 4pt offsets from all text positioning. No Padding section now uses y+0, uniform padding uses y+pad, asymmetric uses y+padT — accurately demonstrating each padding scenario. Rebuild: 0 warnings, 0 errors. Tests: 565 passed. Samples: 10/10.
Cross-provider re-verification with opus (round 2). Verdict in session review.
